skill.displayName: Grok Imagine AI Video Generator – Create Cinematic AI Videos with Native Audio & Scene Control – API-powered
skill.summary: Grok Imagine video generator — create cinematic AI videos with native audio using xAI

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of grok-imagine-video-openapi-skill.
- Generate cinematic AI videos with native audio using xAI via the WeShop OpenAPI.
- Supports image-to-video generation with customizable text description, duration, aspect ratio, and batch size.
- Secure integration requires a WESHOP_API_KEY, used only with openapi.weshop.ai.
- Provides endpoints for starting video generation, polling run status, and uploading images.
